name: Carmex MTI 0604 C12 A60 (MT11)
notes: Carmex Mini Mill-Thread, partial-profile 60deg, internal + external. Real pitch range 0.5-1.0 mm (representative pitch 1.0 used for tooth drawing). Multi-tooth over the full 12.5 mm cutting body, no relieved neck. Test thread: M6x1.0 internal (cutter 4.0 < 5.0 mm bore; reach 12.5 mm > 10 mm hole depth). Grade MT11 PVD coating.

name: Carmex MTI 1212 E39 A60 (MT8)
notes: Carmex Mill-Thread, partial-profile 60deg, internal + external. Real pitch range internal 1.0-1.75 / external 0.8-1.5 mm (representative pitch 1.5 used for tooth drawing). Multi-tooth over the full 30 mm cutting body, no relieved neck. Test threads: M10x1.5 internal, M12x1.75 internal, M8x1.25 external. Reach 30 mm covers all; M10 bore 8.5 mm vs 8.0 mm cutter is tight but valid. Grade MT8 PVD coating.

name: Carmex MTI 1616 E50 A60 (MT8)
notes: Carmex Mill-Thread, partial-profile 60deg, internal + external. Real pitch range internal 2.0-3.0 / external 1.75-2.5 mm (representative pitch 2.5 used for tooth drawing). Multi-tooth over the full 40 mm cutting body, no relieved neck. Test threads: M16x2.0 external, M20x2.5 external. Reach 40 mm covers both. Grade MT8 PVD coating.

name: Carmex MTS 06047 C20 1.0 ISO
notes: Carmex full-profile, pitch-specific 1.0 mm ISO (60deg), internal + external. Fixed pitch 1.0 (full-form crests cut the complete thread profile). Multi-tooth over the full 16 mm cutting body, no relieved neck. Test thread: DEEP M6x1.0 internal (reach 16 mm for deeper M6 holes; spare for the partial-profile MTI 0604). Grade ISO PVD coating.

name: Harvey Tool 890330-C3 single-form
notes: Harvey Tool single-FORM metric thread mill (one 60deg tooth, pitch-independent), internal + external. Cuts any metric pitch; representative pitch 1.0 (designed around M6) used only for tooth drawing. Single tooth (LOC 1.109 mm) on a relieved 2.88 mm neck giving the reach to max thread depth 8.5 mm (shoulderLength = 8.5 - 1.109 = 7.391 mm). Test thread: M6x1.0 internal alternative (shallow, depth <= 8.5 mm; reach 8.5 mm covers it). AlTiN (-C3) coating.

name: Harvey Tool 890339 single-form
notes: Harvey Tool single-FORM metric thread mill (one 60deg tooth, pitch-independent), internal + external. Cuts any metric pitch; representative pitch 2.0 (designed around M16) used only for tooth drawing. Single tooth (LOC 3.164 mm) on a relieved 8.22 mm neck giving the reach to max thread depth 25 mm (shoulderLength = 25 - 3.164 = 21.836 mm). Test thread: M16x2.0 external alternative (boss 18 mm < 25 mm reach). AlTiN coating.
